entry.name: dict.serialize
entry.digest: Convert a dictionary's content to text
entry.description: Use the dict.serialize object to output a serialized form of the contents of dictionary in text format. The text may be Dictionary Syntax, JSON, or Base64-compressed forms of these formats.
